text.p: Linford Christie of Britain marked his final appearance in the European Cup with a record 16th victory in the competition.

The 37-year-old Christie powered away from the 30 metre mark to win the 100 metres in 10.04 seconds, equalling his European Cup record set last year in Madrid. It was also the fastest time run by a European this year.
The 1992 Olympic 100m champion was pushed hard for most of the race by Geir Moen of Norway who was second in 10.18.
Andrey Fedoriv of Russia also finished quickly to finish third in a new personal best of 10.19.
Christie has now won the European Cup 100m on eight consecutive occasions.
"The name of the game is to go out there and rise to the occasion," said Christie after the race.
"To go out there and get a standing ovation from the crowd was the icing on the cake."
Christie will contest the 200m on Sunday to try to add to his impressive record.
The best of the other early events in the Olympic Stadium also saw victories for Olympic champions of the 1992 vintage.

An enthralling men's 1,500m saw the early pace set by Mickael Damian of France but Fermin Cacho of Spain, Olympic gold medallist five years ago, unleashed a devastating burst of speed 40 metres from the line to win in three minutes 37.79 seconds.
"It did not look good for me 300 metres from the line. I was only lying fourth. Fortunately some of my Barcelona finishing spurt was left over."
Gennaro Di Napoli of Italy was a close second in 3:37.81 while Vyacheslav Shabunin of Russia finished third in 3:38.14.
Sally Gunnell of Britain had her best race since she limped out of the Atlanta Olympics 400 metres hurdles semifinal with an achilles tendon injury.
Gunnell, another gold medallist at the Barcelona Games, was ahead from the halfway point and finished strongly in 54.57 seconds.
"After three black seasons, the sun shines again for me," she said. "I know the best were not here but that was not the important thing."
Silvia Rieger of Germany was second in 55.23 with Yeketerina Bakhalova of Russia third in 55.66.
